item.title: 'I have lost my faith in the integrity': Israel-Palestine director of HRW quits over blocked report
item.description: Omar Shakir and assistant researcher Milena Ansari quit after the organisation blocked a report that according to them highlighted Israel's denial of Palestinian refugees' right of return as a crime against humanity.

item.title: WTO on the brink: Reform or fade into irrelevance, warns talks chief
item.description: With global trade rules under strain and US defiance rattling the system, negotiators head to Cameroon facing what one diplomat calls an “existential” moment for the world’s trade watchdog.

item.title: Assassin of Japan's ex-PM appeals life sentence
item.description: Tetsuya Yamagami was sentence to life imprisonment after he admitted to shooting Shinzo Abe with a homemade gun during a campaign speech in 2022.

item.title: Ukraine, Russia and US meet in Abu Dhabi to talk peace
item.description: Negotiators from Kiev, Moscow and Washington convene in Abu Dhabi for two days of talks on ending the Russia-Ukraine war.

item.title: Macron signals possible Putin talks, but says Kremlin not ready for peace
item.description: French president says technical contacts are underway to reopen channels with Moscow, even as Russia’s strikes and rhetoric undermine hopes for near-term negotiations.

item.title: Indonesia's Mount Semeru volcano erupts seven times in just three hours
item.description: Authorities warn people to avoid activities within 500 metres of the Besuk Kobokan riverbank.

item.title: Indonesia's Java landslide death toll rises to 85 as search for missing continues
item.description: Search and rescue operations continue in West Java on the 12th day following a deadly landslide that caused widespread destruction and loss of life.

item.title: French prosecutors seek to uphold 5-year political ban on far-right leader Marine Le Pen
item.description: The appeal trial wraps up later this month while a verdict is expected this summer.

item.title: UNESCO recognition revives hope for Afghan artists in Herat
item.description: UNESCO’s recognition of Kamal ud-Din Behzad’s miniature art offers rare encouragement to artists struggling to keep Herat’s cultural legacy alive.

item.title: Former US First Lady Jill Biden's ex-husband arrested on murder charge in wife's death
item.description: William Stevenson has been charged with the murder of his 64-year-old wife, Linda Stevenson.
